name: TruthVine
shortDescription: A UK CIC providing audio sermon recording, hosting and website integration for evangelical churches, with an optional managed church website service.
suitableContexts: Churches wanting a focused workflow for recording and publishing audio sermons
Evangelical churches seeking sermon hosting that can plug into an existing website
Churches wanting a basic managed website with integrated sermon publishing

pricing.summary: TruthVine publishes sermon hosting at £9.99 per month with a 30-day free trial and no stated long-term commitment. It publishes a template website at a £249 setup fee plus £24 per month; bespoke website design is quoted separately.

tiers.label: Template church website
tiers.detail: Managed website with integrated sermon manager

tiers.label: Bespoke church website
tiers.detail: Supplier publishes a custom-design quote route and monthly fee

pricing.trialDetails: 30-day free trial for TruthVine Sermons; supplier states that there is no long-term commitment and cancellation is available at any time.

dataHosting: The supplier describes a sermon system and a managed website service. Ask for the storage location, hosting provider, data-processing agreement, sub-processors, retention and service-level terms before uploading personal data or recordings that need controlled access.
gdprInformation: Ask the supplier for current service-specific data-processing documentation covering controller and processor roles, hosting, access controls, retention, consent and takedown processes—especially where recordings identify individuals or include prayer requests.
coreFeatures: Audio sermon recording, editing and upload workflow
CD-copy workflow described by the supplier
50GB storage and 50GB monthly bandwidth stated for websites
integrations: Supplier states that the sermon system plugs into an existing website with a single modification
support: Supplier describes email support for website service

uk-purchasing.value: TruthVine C.I.C. identifies itself as a Community Interest Company registered in England and Wales under number 09796696.

gbp-pricing.value: Supplier publishes £9.99/month sermon hosting and GBP prices for template website setup and subscription.

editorial.assessment: TruthVine is a focused UK option for a church whose immediate publishing problem is getting audio sermons onto its website reliably, rather than buying an all-in-one streaming or church-management suite. Its published price and practical recording workflow make it easy to evaluate. The church should still test sound capture, archive ownership, access control, takedown process and compatibility with its current website before moving a sermon archive.
bestFor: Churches with regular audio preaching that need a simpler website-publishing workflow
Evangelical churches wanting focused sermon hosting at a published GBP price
Small teams that may also need a modest managed church website
strengths: Published GBP pricing, trial and cancellation position
UK CIC identity and specific website-service pricing
limitations: Ask the supplier about video streaming, analytics, accessibility transcripts and podcast distribution
Ask for hosting, DPA, sub-processor, archive-migration and exit arrangements
Churches remain responsible for consent, copyright, safeguarding and any personal information contained in recordings

procurementVerdict.problem: Publishing sermon audio consistently without a complicated web workflow
procurementVerdict.differentiator: A specialist recording and website-embedded sermon system with a low published monthly price
procurementVerdict.firstCheck: Use the trial to publish a real recording, test the archive on mobile and confirm the hosting, data and content-exit terms before migrating existing media
